status: prespecified single-seed feasibility, not milestone qualification
semantics: Two independent Boolean traits per entity; absent=false, explicit negation=false. Actions apply to query target. Fire/spark toggle the target light under the supplied law. Initial light is explicit.
counterfactual_pairs: Swap two entities' trait bundles without changing word counts. Keep only pairs with different state labels. BoW state accuracy has a 50% ceiling on complete pairs.
train_test_boundary: Known individual bundles; two joint entity-bundle relationships withheld. Disjoint (rules, question) strings. Test names U/V and description syntax withheld. Laws and trait vocabulary shared: not novel-rule or vocabulary transfer.
monitoring: Validation at 100-update intervals; no checkpoint or hyperparameter selection; held-out once after fixed budget. Tiny failure stops the neural arm.
later_phases: No feedback retention, transfer or learned controller qualification until independent concept generalization is demonstrated. Negative result stops without architecture growth.
